pages.title: Detailed Auto-Crafter
pages.text: The <item>Detailed Auto-Crafter/$ is an upgraded Crafter that can craft <item>$(l:essentials:intro/path)Detailed Crafter/$ specific recipes from any <thing>$(l:essentials:intro/path)path/$.$(br2)It <em>can not/$ craft normal crafting table recipes- only <thing>$(l:essentials:intro/path)path/$ specific recipes. There is a <em>sigil slot/$ in the UI (below the arrow) that takes a <thing>path sigil/$. The <thing>path sigil/$ isn't consumed, but is required to craft recipes from that <thing>$(l:essentials:intro/path)path/$. Once a <thing>path sigil/$ has been used once, it can only be used again for that specific recipe.
